newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht steady, interbank rate lower late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht steady, interbank rate lower late.

text.p: The Thai baht was unchanged against the dollar in late slow trade on Tuesday in line with the greenback's quietness abroad, dealers said.
"The trade was very thin. It's in line with the dollar's tight move against the yen on the close of Japan market," said one dealer at a European bank.
The baht was quoted at 26.125/26.130 to the dollar in late trade, unchanged from the early morning, dealers said.
Some dollar buying had emerged in the afternoon on month-end demand and lower baht short-term interest rates, the dealer added.
The Bank of Thailand set the mid-rate unchanged at 26.11 to the dollar.
The overnight interbank rate edged down to 7.25-7.50 percent late from 7.50 earlier on higher liquidity, dealers said.
"The interbank rate is expected to fall further tomorrow. The liquidity remains plentiful," said one money market dealer.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was traded at 4.00/5.00 satangs per dollar late compared with 4.50/5.00 in the moring.
